The annual report states the trademark registration for RayAI is still IN PROGRESS ('The Company is taking necessary steps for getting the same registered with trademark aut[hority]', page 11, text cut off at a page boundary in extraction - see traps.annual_report_page_break_truncation), i.e. the IP asset sits on the books before the trademark itself is secured.

The BSE entity this pack covers has a market cap of INR 31 crore (~USD 3.5 million at typical INR/USD rates) - roughly 2,500x smaller than the US company sharing its ticker. A symbol-only resolver with no exchange/country disambiguation returns a US lawn-and-turf-equipment multinational for a Chennai marketing-agency SME micro-cap, or vice versa.

eps_history_dilution_trap.detail: screener's own annual EPS series for this company reads: FY22 83.33, FY23 141.27, FY24 84.13, FY25 6.67, FY26 14.29. The FY24-to-FY25 drop (84.13 -> 6.67, a 92% apparent collapse) is NOT an earnings collapse - FY25 net profit (1.26cr) actually grew 19% over FY24 (1.06cr). The paid-up equity capital jumped from INR 0.13cr (Mar 2024) to INR 1.89cr (Mar 2025), a ~14.5x increase in shares outstanding, driven by the Dec-2024 SME IPO (fresh issue plus, likely, a pre-IPO bonus/split - the exact mechanism was not established from the sources fetched in this pass, see world_gaps.pre_ipo_capital_restructure_mechanism_unreached).
eps_history_dilution_trap.consequence: MONEY-RELEVANT. Any automatic multi-year EPS CAGR or 'earnings trend' computed off this raw series returns a catastrophic false collapse for a company whose per-share earnings, correctly read, grew 114% in the most recent year. This is the same class of trap as DHOOTTRANS's traps.unrestated_historical_eps, but caused by IPO-related share issuance rather than an Ind AS 33 bonus restatement, and it appears in THIS pack's own primary source (screener), not merely in a third-party aggregator - i.e. even a pipeline that trusts screener completely still needs a share-count-change guard, not just a source-quality guard.
eps_history_dilution_trap.detection_rule: Any per-share series with a >5x single-period jump should be cross-checked against the paid-up-capital line for the same period before being read as an earnings signal; here 0.13cr -> 1.89cr is the tell.

sme_half_yearly_not_quarterly.detail: This SME-board issuer files HALF-YEARLY results (H1 ended Sep, H2/annual ended Mar), not quarterly. Confirmed directly from the announcement headlines: 'Unaudited Financial Results For The Half Year Ended 30th September, 2025' and 'Audited Financial Results ... For The Quarter And Year Ended As On 31[-03-2026]' are the only two results filings between 2025-04 and 2026-09 - there is no Q1 (Jun) or Q3 (Dec) filing.
sme_half_yearly_not_quarterly.consequence: A pipeline assuming a uniform four-quarters-a-year cadence across all Indian listed names will report this SME name as having 'missing Q1/Q3 results' twice a year, forever, which is not a data gap but a correctly-applied SEBI relaxation for SME issuers under LODR Reg 33.

dividend_field_collision.detail: In this specific case, last_declared_per_share (5.00, the most recent single event) and paid_trailing_12m_per_share (5.00, a sum-over-a-window computation that happens to include only that one event) land on the SAME NUMBER by coincidence, while a third defensible figure - the full FY26 declared total across three interim dividends (8.00) - is different again, and a fourth figure implied by screener's own printed yield (7.50, via a still-different 'last two events by record date' window) is different a fourth time.
dividend_field_collision.consequence: A schema that stores 'the dividend' as one field will silently pick one of four different, individually correct, differently-defined numbers depending on which code path populated it, and the numeric coincidence between two of them (last_declared vs trailing-12m-paid, both 5.00) makes a wiring bug where the wrong one got plumbed through LOOK like it is working correctly.

intra_bse_price_disagreement.detail: getScripHeaderData (High 171.00, Low 162.00) and StockReachGraph (HighVal 175.00, LowVal 160.00) disagree on the day's trading range for the same scrip and session (2026-09-22), matching the same-class trap already documented on S1/DHOOTTRANS. Picking 'the BSE API' as a source is not sufficient; the specific endpoint matters.

annual_report_glyph_numbers.detail: The FY26 Annual Report PDF (817a016c-b8e5-449e-acde-89b962eccf59.pdf) uses a custom/subsetted display font for at least one pull-quote figure: the CFO's-letter revenue callout on page 10 extracts (via pypdf, no OCR) as a private-use-area glyph string ('ʤʧʡʪʣ') instead of readable digits, immediately followed by readable text 'crores in revenue'. Separately, pages 47-53 (the Notice to Shareholders / Board's Report section) extract as WHOLESALE CIPHER-SUBSTITUTED GARBAGE across entire paragraphs (e.g. '0A:K>AHE=>KL*>F;>KLPAHPBEE;>IK>L>GMBGMA>$>G>K:E*>>MBG@' for what is almost certainly 'Shareholders Members who will be present in the General Meeting') - a consistent single-letter substitution cipher, symptomatic of a subsetted font with a broken or absent ToUnicode CMap in exactly that page range.
annual_report_glyph_numbers.consequence: A naive whole-PDF text-extraction-and-keyword-search pipeline gets ZERO usable text from roughly 7 consecutive pages of this filing (the Board's Report - one of the highest-signal sections: related-party transactions, director remuneration, dividend policy statement) while pages 1-11 and 89+ (financial statements) extract cleanly. A keyword search for e.g. 'related party' or 'pledge' across this PDF would silently return no hits from the one section most likely to discuss them, with no visible error - the extraction 'succeeds' (non-empty text, no exception) while being useless for that range.
evidence: https://www.bseindia.com/xml-data/corpfiling/AttachHis/817a016c-b8e5-449e-acde-89b962eccf59.pdf, pages 10 and 47-53, pypdf 6.x, no OCR fallback applied in this pass

rta_address_vs_registered_office.detail: The annual report's identity page prints the Registrar & Share Transfer Agent's Coimbatore address (MUFG Intime India Private Limited, Surya 35, Mayflower Avenue, Coimbatore) directly above/adjacent to the company's own registered-office block (Chennai). A layout-order-dependent scraper of this page could easily attribute the Coimbatore address to the company itself.

exchange_clarification_early_2025.detail: A paired announcement on 2025-01-06 - 'Clarification sought from Toss The Coin Ltd' followed same-day by 'Clarification On Price Movement' - indicates BSE formally queried the company about a price movement roughly three weeks after its Dec-17-2024 listing. The PDF content of either filing was not read in this pass (see world_gaps.price_movement_clarification_content_unreached); flagged because an early-life exchange query about price movement is exactly the kind of governance signal a diligent SME-investing user would want surfaced, not buried in a 66-item announcement list.

thin_liquidity.detail: StockReachGraph's intraday tape for 2026-09-22 shows the session's single largest print at 1,500 shares and long multi-minute stretches with zero incremental volume between LTP updates, on a stock that still moved -5.75% for the day. Any 'volume-weighted' or 'liquidity-adjusted' feature computed the same way as for a mainboard large-cap will behave very differently (much higher effective slippage per unit size) on this name without a data-quality flag distinguishing the two.

differ_guidance.scoring_note: For this name, an app that correctly reports 'BSE-SME, half-yearly reporting, no NSE listing, no pledge filing found' scores ABOVE one that forces a quarterly-cadence / NSE-symbol / pledge-percentage template onto a scrip that structurally does not have those things.
